name: Weißenfels (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Weißenfels (a white castle with a lion on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Weißenfels; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Weißenfels arms — white castle with lion on blue
